properties.description:

Hot Springs Road.

* WHEN...Until 1000 PM AKDT Sunday.

low-water crossings may become impassable. River and stream flows
remain elevated. Ponding of water in areas is occurring or is
imminent.

heavy rain across the Chena River Basin over the past several
days. Between 1.5 and 3 inches of rain has fallen this week.

Rivers. Use extra caution on and along the rivers as water levels
continue to run at near record to record levels for this time of

bankfull. The Chena River below Hunts Creek is dropping but
remains bankfull. The Chena River below Moose Creek Dam is
cresting. The Chena River at Fairbanks will be cresting Saturday
afternoon. We are expecting rivers to remain high through the

week.
